description: Create and update all 30+ screen files implementing complete UI with provider integration. Update existing 12 screens and create 19 new screens including onboarding, budgets, savings, AI assistant, notifications, profile/settings extensions, and help. Update app_router.dart with all new routes. This is the final integration connecting all previous layers into a complete working app.
steps: Create lib/screens/onboarding/onboarding_screen.dart: PageView with 3 slides ('Track Every Shilling' with wallet icon, 'Smart Budgeting' with budget icon, 'Reach Your Goals' with target icon), Skip button, Next/Get Started buttons. On complete, mark onboarding seen and navigate to login.

Update lib/screens/splash/splash_screen.dart: Check onboarding seen flag (use shared_preferences or simple static bool). Route to onboarding if first time, otherwise to login. Keep existing 2 second delay and gradient design.
Update lib/screens/auth/login_screen.dart: Add 'Forgot password?' TextButton below password field linking to /forgot-password route. Integrate AuthProvider for login action.

Update lib/screens/auth/register_screen.dart: Add name field (first), email, password, confirm password with validation using validators.dart. Integrate AuthProvider.register. Match login_screen.dart design.
Create lib/screens/auth/forgot_password_screen.dart: Email TextFormField with validation, 'Send Reset Link' button (UI only, shows success SnackBar). Match login_screen.dart card design.

Update lib/screens/home/home_screen.dart: Replace hardcoded data with DashboardProvider. Show balance card with totalIncome/totalExpenses from provider, monthly budget progress, savings goals summary (2-3 compact goal cards), recent 5 transactions using TransactionCard widget. Keep existing bottom nav (Home/Activity/Add/Reports/Profile). Update greeting to use AuthProvider currentUser name.

Update lib/screens/expenses/add_expense_screen.dart: Add Income/Expense toggle at top using IncomeExpenseToggle widget. Filter categories by selected type using CategoryProvider.getCategoriesByType. On save, call TransactionProvider.addTransaction. Keep existing form layout and validation.

Update lib/screens/expenses/edit_expense_screen.dart: Load transaction from TransactionProvider.getTransactionById, pre-fill all fields including type toggle. Update calls TransactionProvider.updateTransaction, delete button calls deleteTransaction with confirmation dialog.

Update lib/screens/expenses/expense_list_screen.dart: Display TransactionProvider.transactions using TransactionCard widgets. Add filter chips at top (All/Income/Expense), date range picker, category dropdown, search TextField. Swipe-to-delete using Dismissible widget calling TransactionProvider.deleteTransaction.

Update lib/screens/expenses/expense_detail_screen.dart: Show full transaction details from TransactionProvider.getTransactionById - amount, category with icon, date, payment method, description, receipt path (if any). Edit/Delete buttons at bottom.

Create lib/screens/budgets/budgets_screen.dart: ListView of BudgetProvider.budgets using BudgetProgressCard widgets showing spent/limit/status. FloatingActionButton to /add-budget. Each card taps to /budget-detail. Empty state when no budgets.

Create lib/screens/budgets/add_budget_screen.dart: Form with category dropdown (from CategoryProvider, expense categories only), amount field for limit, period selector (Weekly/Monthly/Custom), date range for custom. Save calls BudgetProvider.addBudget. Match add_expense_screen.dart form style.

Create lib/screens/budgets/budget_detail_screen.dart: Budget overview card with progress, list of transactions in that category from TransactionProvider.filterByCategory, edit button navigating to edit form (can reuse add screen with edit mode).

Create lib/screens/savings/savings_screen.dart: ListView of SavingsProvider.goals using SavingsGoalCard widgets showing progress circle, current/target/days remaining. FloatingActionButton to /add-savings-goal. Tap card to /savings-detail.

Create lib/screens/savings/add_savings_goal_screen.dart: Form with goal name, target amount, target date (DatePicker), initial amount (optional). Save calls SavingsProvider.addGoal. Match add_expense form style.

Create lib/screens/savings/savings_detail_screen.dart: Goal overview card with circular progress, current/target amounts, days remaining, monthly target suggestion from SavingsService. Add/Withdraw buttons showing amount dialogs calling SavingsProvider.addToGoal/withdrawFromGoal. Edit/Delete buttons.

Update lib/screens/reports/reports_screen.dart: Replace hardcoded chart data with AnalyticsProvider (create if not in FEAT-003, or use services directly). Date range selector at top. BarChart showing monthly trend from AnalyticsService.getMonthlyTrend. PieChart showing spending by category from AnalyticsService.getSpendingByCategory. Top 5 categories list. Period comparison card showing percentage vs previous period.

Create lib/screens/ai/ai_chat_screen.dart: ListView.builder displaying AIProvider.chatHistory using chat bubble widgets (user messages right-aligned blue, AI messages left-aligned white). TextField at bottom with send button and mic button (mic shows 'Voice input coming soon' SnackBar). Show example questions when chat is empty. Integrate AIProvider.sendMessage.

Create lib/screens/ai/ai_analysis_screen.dart: Display spending patterns analysis using AnalyticsService data. Cards showing: unusual spending (transactions > 2x category average), category comparisons (current vs previous month), top spending categories. Use ChartWidget for visualizations.

Create lib/screens/ai/ai_recommendations_screen.dart: Display savings tips, budget suggestions (categories over threshold), goal timeline projections. Each recommendation in a card with accept/dismiss buttons (UI only, show SnackBar on action).

Update lib/screens/categories/categories_screen.dart: TabBar with Income/Expense tabs. Each tab shows CategoryProvider.getCategoriesByType(type) in ListView using CategoryIcon widget and name. Default categories show no delete button, custom categories show delete icon calling CategoryProvider.deleteCategory with confirmation. FloatingActionButton to /add-category.

Create lib/screens/categories/add_category_screen.dart: Form with name field, type selector (Income/Expense), icon picker (GridView of Material Icons showing common icons as IconButtons), color picker (Wrap of colored circles). Save calls CategoryProvider.addCategory. Match form style.

Create lib/screens/notifications/notifications_screen.dart: ListView of NotificationProvider.notifications with leading icon based on type, title/message, timestamp, unread indicator dot. Tap marks as read via NotificationProvider.markAsRead. AppBar action button 'Clear All' calls markAllAsRead. Empty state when no notifications.

Update lib/screens/profile/profile_screen.dart: Display AuthProvider.currentUser name, email. Avatar placeholder (CircleAvatar with initials). Account stats cards (total transactions, active budgets, goals count). Edit Profile button to /edit-profile. Integrate AuthProvider data.

Create lib/screens/profile/edit_profile_screen.dart: Form with name, email, avatar selection button (shows 'Image picker coming soon' for now). Save updates AuthProvider.currentUser. Match form style.

Update lib/screens/settings/settings_screen.dart: ListView of setting tiles grouped by sections. Account: currency selector (default UGX), theme toggle (ThemeProvider), language (UI only). Notifications: navigate to /notification-settings. Security: Change Password link to /change-password, PIN/Biometric (UI only). Data: Export/Backup (UI only). About: Help, Version, Sign Out (calls AuthProvider.logout).

Create lib/screens/settings/change_password_screen.dart: Form with current password, new password, confirm password fields with validators. Save button (UI only, shows success SnackBar). Match form style.

Create lib/screens/settings/notification_settings_screen.dart: SwitchListTiles for: budget alerts, goal reminders, weekly summaries, transaction reminders. State stored locally (can use simple bool variables for now, future: shared_preferences).

Create lib/screens/help/help_screen.dart: ExpansionTiles for FAQ sections (Getting Started, Budgets, Savings, Transactions). Static Q&A content. Contact Support button (shows email/help dialog UI only). App version at bottom.

Update lib/core/routes/app_router.dart: Add all new route constants and cases in AppRoutes class and generateRoute switch: /onboarding, /forgot-password, /budgets, /add-budget, /budget-detail, /savings, /add-savings-goal, /savings-detail, /ai-chat, /ai-analysis, /ai-recommendations, /notifications, /edit-profile, /change-password, /notification-settings, /help, /add-category. Import all new screen files.
acceptance_criteria: All 31 screen files exist (12 updated + 19 new) with proper provider integration
Screens consume data from providers using Consumer or Provider.of, no hardcoded data except for UI-only features
All forms use validators from lib/utils/validators.dart
All screens use widgets from lib/widgets/ where applicable (TransactionCard, BudgetProgressCard, etc.)
app_router.dart has all 31 routes properly configured
Onboarding flow works: splash -> onboarding (first time) -> login -> home
All CRUD operations integrate with appropriate providers
No compilation errors, app builds and runs successfully
verification: Run 'flutter analyze' and confirm no errors
Run 'flutter build apk --debug' or 'flutter build ios --debug' to verify compilation

Run 'flutter run' on emulator/device and verify: onboarding shows on first launch, can navigate all screens from bottom nav and buttons, can add transaction/budget/goal and see it in lists, all forms validate correctly
Verify no hardcoded data in screens except UI placeholders, all data comes from providers
